physicalEvidence.status: Prior-host learned robot verified; current FAU learned execution not fully verified
physicalEvidence.summary: The full 2024 Neural L1 manuscript, listed by the PI as ICRA 2025, learns uncertainty compensation for lateral control and tests a real F1TENTH with Jetson Xavier NX, ROS2 and PhaseSpace localization. Experiments track a 2.5m-radius circle at 0.5/1.0m/s with injected noise/steering disturbance and a ramp/planks. The paper explicitly locates these trials at Minnesota Robotics Institute; they are prior-host hardware, not current FAU equipment. Current FAU 2026 undergraduate proceedings separately document a supervised Husky/ZED autonomous waypoint project with OptiTrack validation, but do not establish a trained policy, so it receives no extra learned-execution credit.
